\label{lesson:HI-C166-sucna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Hindi for to play (an instrument), to ring, then the Hindi for to count.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \hi{सूचना}}
\textbf{\hi{सूचना}} — \emph{sūcnā} — \textquotedblleft{}a notice, information\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the notice on the door — \textbf{\hi{आज} \hi{दुकान} \hi{बंद} \hi{है।}} (\emph{āj dukān band hai.})

The shop is closed today, so come back \emph{kal}.
